tips.text: Refine the Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave the Blueprint relics Intact.
Crack the Rare relics in a Radiant radshare squad.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Barrel and Receiver relics; they carry the Rares.
